Chapter 473: Chapter 14 The Long Three Hundred Years 2 (The title of the previous chapter was wrong, the content wasn’t affected)

“This is actually a cosmic force?”

Lin Yuan observed repeatedly and finally came to a conclusion.

The Innate Purple Qi mastered by the elder in the purple robe was, in the Main World, a cosmic force that only an invincible being at the Eighth Layer could control.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan fell silent for a moment, suddenly enlightened.

No wonder the Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings of the Spirit Realm, without the support of an inner world, could rival the Evolvers of the Eighth Layer in the Main World.

...

The world force emanating from the inner world of the Eighth Layer Evolvers allowed human Evolvers to catch up with those Innate, powerful special life-forms.

There are few forces at the same level that can match the amplification of world force on Evolvers.

But cosmic force is definitely one of them.

Even the surge in combat power caused by cosmic force is above that of world force.

The Innate Purple Qi of the elder in the purple robe, being only partly mastered, could once perfected, even without the world force, rival the peak Evolvers of the Eighth Layer.

“Those Supreme Immortal Kings, without an inner world, yet able to rival the invincibles of the Eighth Layer, must possess a Power of Creation that definitely belongs to a higher cosmic force…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The invincible ones of the Eighth Layer in the Main World also vary in strength, though the strongest cannot defeat the weakest, they can still suppress them, and the difference lies in the different cosmic forces.

Some cosmic forces are simply stronger than others, and the former are known as higher cosmic forces.

“Opportunity.”

“This is the greatest opportunity of my travel through the realms!”

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly—what was the greatest help that his eighth traversal brought him?

Was it opening the Eighth Stage Martial Tao?

No.

The Eighth Layer Part could be perfected anywhere.

Even without traversing realms, given time in the Main World, Lin Yuan could still achieve it.

Comprehending the Rule Model of Space?

There was no difference from opening the Eighth Stage Martial Tao.

It was not exclusive to the Spirit Realm.

Before knowing that the Power of Creation wielded by the Immortal Kings was equivalent to cosmic force,

traversing to the Spirit Realm saved Lin Yuan time and allowed for references to the Immortal Cultivation System and other systems.

But now,

having confirmed the essence of the Power of Creation,

Lin Yuan was utterly sure that the Power of Creation was his greatest gain.

It was irreplaceable, an unparalleled gain.

In the Main World Universe Starry Sky, every cosmic force is unique, incapable of being replicated or simulated.

Once a being grasps a certain cosmic force, no other life can grasp that same force.

This is a rule from the Main World.

Here, ‘Rule’ is not about gold, wood, water, fire, earth, thunder, light, and other such rules.

It refers to the ‘restrictions’ from the Main World.

Just like below the Supreme Being, all life has a limit to its lifespan.

This is also a rule of the Main World.

And in the Cosmic Starry Skies, the fastest speed is the speed of light, surpass it and you enter wormholes.

This too is a rule of the Main World.

“The ‘restrictions’ of the Main World do not apply in the Spirit Realm, at least not to cosmic forces; the Spirit Realm is much more lenient—there’s no rule that a certain Power of Creation can only be wielded by one Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.”

Lin Yuan’s mind was slightly thrilled, meaning he could completely grasp a great number of Powers of Creation in the Spirit Realm.

Then, upon returning to the Main World, these powers would collectively transform into cosmic forces.

The Main World’s Starry Sky Races have a long history, birthing many invincible beings at the Eighth Layer, but the vast majority of them master only one cosmic force.

A very few, due to various accidents, have mastered two cosmic forces, which is already the limit.

For a normal Eighth Layer powerhouse, there are two goals: one is to step into the Ninth Rank, or to master some cosmic force.

But for an invincible at the Eighth Layer, there is only one goal, and that is to step into the Ninth Rank.

Only by breaking through to the Ninth Rank can one extend life, and continuing to contemplate other cosmic forces is, aside from being foolish or not, the key question is—can they really grasp it?

Grasping each cosmic force contains an element of luck; there’s no fixed direction. How can you be sure that the direction you choose will lead to a cosmic force?

…

This is precisely why Lin Yuan was excited.

If he hadn’t discovered the essence of the Power of Creation, even if he knew that the Spirit Realm didn’t have as many restrictions on cosmic force,

he wouldn’t have had any other ideas.

To grasp more cosmic forces? Keep in mind that before fully understanding the Taiyang and Taiyang Rules, even Lin Yuan didn’t know that the Taiji force would be a cosmic force.

Even with the Against-Heaven’s Understanding, grasping the next cosmic force would waste a lot of time, causing his other pursuits to slow or even stop.

But now,

with a clear path to pursue the Power of Creation, all Lin Yuan needed to do was like delving into the Evolution Path—spend time contemplating and sensing it.

Grasping a Power of Creation in the Spirit Realm and returning to the Main World meant having a unique cosmic force.

“Innate Purple Qi… The human civilization’s records of many invincible beings at the Eighth Layer do not mention anyone possessing this cosmic force…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, though it was also possible that an invincible being of the Eighth Layer not recorded in history possessed the Innate Purple Qi cosmic force.

But the likelihood was low, and Lin Yuan’s goal was not just to understand the Innate Purple Qi cosmic force. He planned to go through all the Powers of Creation possessed by other Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings.

“Human civilization’s interpretation of cosmic force is greatly helpful for stepping into the Ninth Rank in the future. Theoretically, the more cosmic forces one masters, the greater this help, but this is not emphasized much because it remains theoretical.”

Lin Yuan silently reflected.
